name: Clinton Becker
prior_offices: Converse County sheriff (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Clinton Becker, also listed as Clint Becker, is the Converse County sheriff and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official general election summary lists him as the winner of the sheriff race.
